title: Create, Update, Delete Operations
description: Use Prisma Client create, update, delete, and upsert methods to modify data.

data.text: Prisma Client provides straightforward methods for creating, updating, and deleting records: `create`, `createMany`, `update`, `updateMany`, `delete`, `deleteMany`, and `upsert`.

data.title: Create a Record
data.content: Create a new user with a related profile.

data.title: Update and Delete
data.content: Update a user and delete a post.

data.text: `upsert` updates a record if it exists, or creates it if it does not. This is useful for idempotent operations.
